title: Withdrawal of Circular NoIRDA_DIST_BRK_CIR_205_10_2013.pdf367 KB
full_text:
> **t,i,i#leD INSURANCE REGULATORY AND ir.tai DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** 

No.IRDA/BRK/MISC/CIR/120/05/2017 

> 24th May 2017. 

To 

> POs of Insurance Broking companies 

> CEOs of all insurance companies 

**No.IRDA/DIST /BRK/CIR/205/10/2013 dt.30.10.2013.** Reg. **Withdrawal of Circular** 

This to bring to your notice that Circular No.IRDA/DIST/BRK/CIR/205/10/2013 dt.30.10.2013, stands withdrawn with immediate _effect._ Henceforth furnishing of data in compliance of the said circular is need not be submitted to the Authority. 

> The insurance broker shall submit at the time of renewal of license, in cases, where license is renewed alter the due date, stating that "no 

> business was underwritten during the break-in period of the license". 

> an undertaking, 

ij (Ran i ingh Jagpal) Chief General Manager
